What Scale AI sells

Provides expert training data and AI testing. It also builds AI applications for businesses and governments.

  • Scale Data Engine · Training data and annotation (labels added to data so models can learn).
  • Scale GenAI Portfolio · AI applications for work inside businesses.
  • Scale Donovan · AI applications for government users.

Risks and disputes

Dated events

DateEventStatusSources
Sep 2025
Lawsuit		Scale AI sued Mercor and a former employee over trade secrets
Scale alleged that a former employee took confidential customer documents when he joined Mercor, which Mercor said it never accessed. The parties settled on confidential terms and the case was dismissed with prejudice in January 2026.		Settled, dismissed with prejudiceU.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. · TechCrunch
Jul 2025
Workforce change		Scale AI cut about 14% of staff and ended work with about 500 contractors
A spokesperson confirmed cuts of 200 full-time roles and about 500 contractors. In a staff memo, interim CEO Jason Droege wrote that Scale had ramped up its generative AI capacity too quickly.		Confirmed by companySFGATE · TechCrunch
Dec 2024
Lawsuit		Contributors sued Scale AI alleging they were misclassified as contractors
Led by McKinney v. Scale AI in San Francisco Superior Court, the suits sought unpaid wages for California contributors. Scale denies the claims, and a $12.5 million settlement awaits a final approval hearing on October 30, 2026.		Settlement awaiting final approvalSimpluris, settlement administrator · SFGATE · TechCrunch
